images.name: sanctuary_props
images.prompt: Original cozy fantasy adventure game props, warm hand-painted storybook illustration, the same consistent slightly overhead three-quarter camera for every object, amber upper-left light, cool deep teal shadows, copper metal, carved old wood, muted mossy slate stone. Simple bold silhouettes readable at 32 pixels, three broad value groups, sparse small details. No photorealism, no characters, no text, no letters, no symbols resembling writing. A PROFESSIONAL SPRITE SHEET with exactly THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, SIX equal square cells. One complete isolated game prop centered in each cell, generous empty margins, no overlap. First row from left to right: (1) a square wooden seed CRATE with crossed timber braces and copper corners, closed flat lid, unmistakably a pushable box; (2) a mechanical SWITCH with a long copper lever tilted left, set into a squat mossy stone pedestal, large handle visible; (3) a very flat circular PRESSURE PLATE lying on the floor, dark central wooden disk inset into a thick copper ring, no pedestal, no vertical parts. Second row from left to right: (4) an archery TARGET made of a large upright circular copper ring with a dark turquoise center and bright cream bullseye, held by two short stone feet; (5) a small tall freestanding LAMP with a cream glass globe held within curved copper leaf ribs on a narrow dark teal stem and round stone foot, no lever and no target ring; (6) a stationary magical TURRET, a squat mossy stone owl automaton on a broad circular base, two amber eye lenses and a short round copper emitter projecting forwards from its chest, no wheels, no legs. Entire canvas a plain uniform saturated MAGENTA backdrop. No surrounding landscape, no ground square, no scenery, no base tile, no border, no visible grid, no drop shadow outside objects. Six separate usable assets, all fully inside their cells.

images.name: indoor_floor
images.prompt: A single flat seamless material texture filling the whole square edge to edge, painted for a top-down storybook adventure game. Strict overhead surface with uniform diffuse lighting everywhere. Extremely low contrast, small evenly distributed brush texture, a few tiny chips. Absolutely no central highlight, no vignette, no borders, no scenery, no objects, no frame, no perspective, no light beam, no large cracks, no drawn tile grid. All edges have matching brightness and color statistics. Calm continuous material, useful after downsampling to 32 pixel game tiles. Material: old smooth limestone floor, muted medium-light gray sage and soft pale olive, warm ivory speckles very sparse, broad quiet muted colors. No plants, no grass, no pathways, no brown earth. Restrained hand-painted surface using a small family of closely related sage-gray colors.

images.name: sanctuary_active
images.prompt: Edit this exact six-cell game sprite sheet. Preserve every object design, rendering style, camera angle, scale, framing, background and cell placement. Change only the active mechanism states: top-middle copper lever is tilted the OPPOSITE way with a bright warm amber light on its base; top-right flat pressure plate central disk is depressed and glows softly amber; bottom-left target bullseye and two inner rings shine bright amber; bottom-middle lamp globe shines bright amber. Leave the top-left crate and bottom-right owl turret unchanged. The four active objects must be noticeably illuminated with broad readable golden highlights, but no glow outside their silhouette. Exact same three columns and two rows, six complete isolated objects, plain magenta background, no text.

images.name: lamp_off
images.prompt: Edit this exact freestanding lamp illustration. Turn the light completely OFF: no flame, no glow, no warm light inside the glass globe. Show a dark cool smoky blue-gray glass globe with a small soft pale reflection, unlit. Preserve the exact same copper leaf ribs, teal stem, stone pedestal, geometry, camera angle and hand-painted style. The lamp is unchanged except that it is OFF. Entire lamp fully visible with generous plain magenta margins, centered. No added objects, no text.
